x: Al cursed his luck as he ploughed through flowerbeds to get back onto the route. He reckoned he'd lost about 30 secs. and was now in 4th position which he maintained to the finish.
Al was 56th on lap one and although his lap times showed that he gradually slowed down throughout the race, he was up to 8th at the finish and breathing down Roger's neck.

Not wanting to be outdone by his Captain, Alaster Stewart had grimly nodded as he received encouragement from clubmates in the take-over zone and now, out in the Buckinghamshire sunshine, Al slowly reeled in the black and white clad leader.

Al Stewart 4th in 32:28 was followed by Mal Byansi 9th 34:10, Paul Smoothy 17th 35:42 and Will Cockerell 20th 36:16. Toby Tanser won over 5 miles in New York on January 7th, 25:19, and a week later was first home again in a 10 kms races with 31:59.
Flogging himself up that final stretch his legs were "gone" and there wasn't an ounce of effort left in him as he lay panting on his back having sent Al Stewart on his way.
Then there’s Messrs Hadfield, Hegvold and Ellacott et al. all lurking in the wings. And the best bit was meeting so many new faces – around half a dozen, fantastic.

…lew around the short stage to remove 3 seconds from our Club Best by a Junior. … And then back to another old stager in Al Stewart – out of the team since 2003 but in the three appearances up to that date – silver, gold and gold!…
